note: Supporting-document availability from the [POW FOR REVIEW] Program of Works drop. Packages are parsed as work-type / system / amount from folder and file names (region -> IMO/province -> category -> project nesting), then fuzzy-matched to Senate workbook submission titles within the same region, with province and category boosts. Matches are triage candidates, not certified identity. Unsupported means no package in this drop mapped to the Senate row. Weak filename matches are re-checked against POW PDF text (native layer; OCR only where tesseract exists). Local path is configured in extract_pow_review_availability.py (or NIA_POW_ROOT); canonical upstream is the PBC Google Drive folder.
